prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic overhead full-body fashion portrait of one original approved adult woman lying on a plain white studio surface.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with long dark hair spread naturally, neutral expression, natural skin texture and minimal makeup. She wears the supplied white long-sleeve crop top, white briefs with supplied waistband branding, white socks and white sneakers, with arms extended above her head and legs lightly crossed at the ankles.
composition_elements: Centered overhead vertical full-body composition with hair spread naturally and all limbs and footwear visible.
Plain white background with soft diffuse lighting and minimal shadows.
Preserve supplied white garments, waistband branding, hair placement, ankle crossing and clean monochrome contrast.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffuse overhead light with minimal shadows, clean neutral exposure, controlled garment texture and modern editorial atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 overhead portrait, full-frame camera at ISO 400, 50mm lens at f/4, 1/125s, deep focus across subject, realistic cotton, skin, hair and shoe texture, no added text or watermark.
